Container.Name: channels-dvr
Container.Overview:
Channels DVR Server for Unraid.
Based on Debian Bookworm with minimal tini init system.
Key Features: - Proper PUID/PGID mapping (no root-owned files) - TV Everywhere (TVE) support with Google Chrome - Intel QuickSync and NVIDIA GPU transcoding - App handles its own updates (including pre-releases)
GPU Setup:
Intel QuickSync: 1. Edit this container, scroll to Intel GPU (in Advanced View) 2. Set the value to: /dev/dri 3. Apply
NVIDIA GPU: 1. Install Nvidia-Driver plugin from Community Apps 2. Edit this container, add --gpus all to Extra Parameters 3. In Advanced View, set NVIDIA Visible Devices to: all 4. Apply and verify with: docker exec channels-dvr nvidia-smi

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Container Path: /channels-dvr - Stores Channels DVR configuration and binary

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Container Path: /shares/DVR - Where recordings are stored

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID - Use 99 for nobody on Unraid

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID - Use 100 for users on Unraid

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: For Intel QuickSync hardware transcoding, set this to: /dev/dri

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: To enable NVIDIA GPU: 1) Install Nvidia-Driver plugin from Community Apps, 2) Add --gpus all to Extra Parameters above, 3) Set this to: all

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Leave as default (compute,video,utility) for transcoding. Only change if you know what you're doing.
